hotelDescription:
Take centre stage at Premier Inn London Leicester Square, right in the heart of the West End. With our friendly team and extra-comfy beds you'll get that all-singing, all-dancing London experience but without the blockbuster prices. 

You're perfectly placed for the West End shows, restaurants and bars. You'll find endless shopping at Oxford Street and Covent Garden. And there's culture and history just minutes away, from Trafalgar Square to Buckingham Palace. And, because we're so central, you're never far from a place to put your feet up and prepare for the encore.
hotelDirections: Nearest tube stations are Leicester Sq (Northern and Piccadilly lines). Follow Cranbourne St into Leicester Sq and the hotel is located on the right (Leicester Pl). Bus routes serving Charing Cross, Haymarket, Shaftsbury Ave and Trafalgar Sq are a short walk away. Charing Cross stn, served by South East Rail is under 10 mins walk. Local car parks include China Town and Witcombe St, both are under 10 mins walk away and are chargable.
parkingDescription: There is no on-site parking available at this hotel. Chargeable off-site parking is available at Q-Park Chinatown (sat nav WC2H 7PR) at £36 for 24 hours. Height restriction 1.98m

donations.title: Support the Disasters Emergency Committee and the humanitarian effort in Ukraine
donations.info: We’ve all seen the humanitarian crisis affecting the people of the Ukraine. Our hearts are with all those whose lives have been affected by these devastating events, and the unimaginable suffering caused by this needless human tragedy. 100% of your donation will go to The Disasters Emergency Committee (DEC) in support of their international humanitarian aid effort. It's the task of this charity to supply food, water, first aid, medicine, warm clothes, and shelter for refugees, which is why any support you can offer today will be invaluable in helping the people of Ukraine.*

restaurant.name: The Kitchen
restaurant.description: Full and Continental breakfasts, a hearty evening meal, a light snack or a relaxing drink. At The Kitchen you can enjoy it all at reasonable prices. Restaurant opening hours may vary.

menus.name: Breakfast
menus.description: Tuck into our unlimited breakfast from just £9.50*. And don’t forget, kids eat free when an adult orders a full Premier Inn breakfast – what’s not to love! Our great value, all-you-can-eat cooked breakfast includes favourites like freshly cooked bacon, fluffy hash browns, succulent sausages, eggs as you like them, and more. Our continental breakfast is a lighter option, with fruit, cereal and freshly baked pastries – and as always, everything in the continental breakfast is included in the Premier Inn Breakfast. We’ll confirm which breakfast options will be available at your selected hotel during booking. *Prices may vary. At some restaurants our Premier Inn Breakfast is £10.50
menus.disclaimer: Depending on your selected hotel and dates you stay, we will be offering different breakfast and evening options.

menus.name: Dinner
menus.description: Tuck into all your Premier Inn restaurant favourites like chicken tikka curry or a margherita pizza, and there’s even a new mac and cheese for the little ones! Then enjoy a luxury sticky toffee pudding or get stuck into a delicious triple chocolate brownie for dessert.
menus.disclaimer: Depending on your selected hotel and dates you stay, we will be offering different breakfast and evening options.

menus.name: Meal Deal
menus.description: Fancy saving up to 20% with our tempting Meal Deal offer? Enjoy a delicious two course dinner plus a selected drink*, then wake up and tuck into our famous unlimited all-you-can-eat Premier Inn Breakfast the next day. Plus, up to two under-16s also eat breakfast for free when an adult orders a Meal Deal. We’ll confirm at booking if our Meal Deal is available at your selected hotel.
menus.disclaimer: Depending on your selected hotel and dates you stay, we will be offering different breakfast and evening options.
